answer: I would stop farms with Licensed coastguard watch record with coastguards confirmation, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 454 pays 7718 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. A lotus of doubt is healthy, a glacier of proof is required, and a vault of patience is the price of a clean panel. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
